input: arr contains n positive safe integers in leaf order. Let H be their maximum or zero when empty; require max(n-1,0)*H*H <= 9007199254740991. Empty/singleton input is accepted as a zero-cost extension. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. Python integer inputs are plain int excluding bool; any separately declared floating probabilities are ordinary float.
return: Minimum sum of non-leaf node values over full binary trees with the given inorder leaves, where each non-leaf value is the product of the largest leaf in each child subtree. Empty/singleton input returns zero.
mutation_aliasing: Input and aliases remain unchanged. The private monotonic stack stores scalar leaf maxima; no output tree is constructed. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Every performed product is at most H^2 and there are n-1 products when n>=1, so all products and accumulation are exact safe integers. No infinite sentinel or bitwise coercion is used. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n + 1) time and O(n + 1) auxiliary space. The stack is strictly decreasing; removing a local smaller-or-equal value pairs it with the smaller available dominating neighbor. Each value is pushed and removed at most once. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 484 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper definition, Solution wrapper, signatures, loops, built-in calls, comments/annotations, whitespace and terminal newline. Shared helper spelling is fully charged in each candidate, not a free library. No imports, runtime-generated implementation, external helper or hidden expansion is used.
